description: Report a bug, a missing capability, or an improvement idea about Unseen's tools or output to the Unseen team. No sign-in needed and free. Use it whenever a tool errors, behaves unexpectedly, or you had to work around something. Describe the problem in your own words (what you called, what you expected, what happened). Never include document contents, personal data or credentials.

buildVersion.description: Optional client/deployment version or environment hint (max 64 chars).

errorCode.description: Optional short error code or errorKind observed (e.g. 'unsupported_edit', 'not_found').

expectedBehavior.description: Optional concise description of what you expected (max 300 chars, no document contents).

graphStats.description: Optional counts only. Never include labels, source text or graph data.

jobId.description: Optional related workflow ID (max 80 chars), associated only for a verified owner.

message.description: What happened and what you would change (max 1500 characters). No document contents.

observedBehavior.description: Optional concise description of what happened instead (max 300 chars, no document contents).

tool.description: Optional tool name the feedback is about, e.g. compile_workflow.

name: send_feedback
title: Send Feedback To The Unseen Team
